review.wirePersistenceRuntimeImpact: No packet or RPC format change. Zero-hop paths now retain direct Header1 addressing instead of incorrectly inserting the shared owner's transport identity; positive-hop forwarding is unchanged. Strict clients require authenticated control on admission and reconnect; strict owners never join another owner. Client dynamic local spawns are rejected. Owned RPC tasks are drained at shutdown and sessions bounded. AutoInterface ports and generic automatic startup remain unchanged. The previously reviewed opt-in BLE firmware persistence policy remains intact. Route recovery observes bounded local dispatch versions and invalidates only the unchanged attempted route, without receive-interface suppression. Link and packet ownership are separate. Ordinary packet timeout calculation is consolidated without changing its formula. Shared clients recover only their local actor; no new shared RPC or wire messages.
